champion.name: direct position-specific ensemble
champion.note: the frozen production forecast center; this prompt may not change it

challengers.name: bayesian_ridge_only
challengers.construction: the identical pipeline with model_families restricted to ('bayesian',) and stack_weight_cap 1.0
challengers.rationale: does the four-family stack earn its complexity over one linear learner?

challengers.name: hist_gradient_boosting_only
challengers.construction: the identical pipeline with model_families restricted to ('gradient_boosting',) and stack_weight_cap 1.0
challengers.rationale: does the stack earn its complexity over one compact boosted-tree learner?

forbidden: adding a learner family beyond the two named challengers
adding, removing or re-engineering any model feature
retuning anything after the 2025 checkpoint is inspected
selecting the reported metric, season subset, stratum or seed after seeing results
promoting on the strength of a stratum that was not preregistered here

development.use: every promotion decision is made here and nowhere else

locked_regression_checkpoint.use: inspected exactly once, after the development decision is written; may confirm or veto a promotion, may never create one

prospective_final_judge.use: final judge; graded only once real 2026 results exist

primary_metric: MAE in fantasy points per player-week over the development outer seasons

resampling.unit: season-week block, every player in a week resampled together

promotion_gate.source_of_thresholds: data/accuracy_registry.json accept_gates and release_thresholds, and analysis/accuracy_protocol.json acceptance/calibration blocks

noninferiority_record.definition: CI95 upper bound of the champion-minus-challenger MAE difference is below 0.05 and every guardrail in promotion_gate holds
noninferiority_record.consequence: recorded as noninferior; NEVER a promotion on its own

default_decision: keep the current ensemble; a challenger that does not clear every condition is recorded as rejected with its numbers, and no threshold is revisited
